issues.area: Gameplay / snow (merged v0.5.0, found during the Windows snow race, reproduced on Linux)
issues.problem: In snow, a car that comes to a standstill against a guardrail can never move again. Full throttle plus steering away from the rail leaves it at 0 km/h with x unchanged, for good. The stage can only be left via 'Etappe neu starten' or 'Aufgeben'. The trigger is ordinary: a collision pushes the car into the rail (it ends at 10 km/h), and holding only gas leaves it stuck within about 1 s. Pulling over to the right during a police stop is a likely route too. Regression from v0.5.0: commit b83749f added the snow traction limit; the guardrail scrape already existed.
issues.evidence: Wine run (menus → Bern–Mailand, Schnee, Limousine): at 0:32 a collision flash at 111 km/h. From 0:55.95 to 3:50.90 the car stands at km 13.8 at 0 km/h against the right guardrail while gas and full left steering are held. Re-pressing gas changes nothing. Escape still opens the pause menu, so input arrives (shots/snow_softlock_sheet.png, w4_drive_sheet.png, w4_unstuck_sheet.png, w4_19_pause_c.png). Deterministic repro on Linux: `godot --headless --path . -s .../qa050/windows/scripts/repro_rail_stuck.gd` → 'limousine snow traction 11.9 vs scrape 20.0 km/h/s | pinned: speed 0.0 … | after 10 s throttle+left: speed 0.0 km/h, x 7.195 -> 7.195, left the rail: NEVER'. Same result for sportwagen, kompakt and kombi; dry and rain leave the rail after 0.05–0.35 s (logs/repro_rail_stuck.log). repro_rail_crash.gd (collision pushes the car into the rail): snow with throttle only gives 0.0 km/h at the rail after 15 s; dry and rain creep along it at 11 km/h (logs/repro_rail_crash.log). Cause: scripts/gameplay/vehicle_model.gd:386 caps acceleration at traction_mps2(g) = 9·g^1.25 (config/game_config.json:101), which is 11.9 km/h/s for snow grip 0.45. That is below the guardrail scrape of 20 km/h/s (vehicle_model.gd:525, config/game_config.json:107), so every frame's gain is scraped off again. Steering scales with speed (vehicle_model.gd:416, ramp = v/60), so the sideways move stays under the 0.5 mm clamp tolerance and is snapped back to lim_r (vehicle_model.gd:497-502).
issues.fix: In VehicleModel._apply_road_limits (vehicle_model.gd:516-525), apply the scrape only while the car presses into the rail (lat_speed·side > 0 or push_speed·side > 0), and never more than the tyres can deliver: e.g. minf(_rail_scrape, 0.5·traction_mps2(road grip)·3.6), or scale the scrape with the grip. In _steer (vehicle_model.gd:416), give the steering a minimum ramp (e.g. 0.2) when off_road == 2 and the input points away from the rail, so a standing car can always be steered off. Add a regression test (e.g. tests/unit/race/test_guardrail_escape.gd built from repro_rail_stuck.gd): a car pinned at standstill at the left or right rail must leave it and pass 20 km/h within 5 s with throttle and steering away, for every car and for normal/rain/snow. Config-only stopgap: driving.guardrail.scrape_decel_kmh_s ≤ 10 (below the 11.9 km/h/s snow traction).
